payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all pairs of indices (i,j) with a 2D DP table storing best score for substrings ending at i and j, using recurrence that adds 3 on match, subtracts 1 for length, and clips to non-negative.
payload.rationale: Solution uses explicit 2D state dp[i][j] indicating the maximal similarity score for substrings ending at i-1 and j-1, updated from three neighbors with length penalty, classic dp_2d_state.
